description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of different parameter-efficient fine-tuning design spaces. The horizontal axis displays the categories of design spaces—Increasing, Uniform, Decreasing, Spindle, and Bottleneck—listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Each design space is represented by a set of five gray bars. The bars for the “Increasing” design space range in height from approximately 0.2 to 0.6. The “Uniform” design space bars are consistently around 0.3 in height. The “Decreasing” design space bars range from approximately 0.6 to 0.2. The “Spindle” design space bars range from approximately 0.3 to 0.7. Finally, the “Bottleneck” design space bars range from approximately 0.2 to 0.5. No bars are visually emphasized, and the bars within each category are not sorted in any apparent order.
